adapters.description: AI-Verse OS discovers the external canonical AI-Verse-Skills installation and its manifest directly. No skill packages, copies or symlinks are placed inside the OS repository.
Expose portable skill package directories to Agent Skills-compatible runtimes.
Link/copy selected installed packages into a user-selected Claude skills directory when explicitly requested.
Link/copy selected installed packages into a user-selected Codex skills directory when explicitly requested.
Expose packages to a user-selected Hermes skills directory while preserving original package content.
Expose packages to a user-selected OpenClaw skill root; runtime permissions remain OpenClaw-owned.
Expose packages to a user-selected Gemini skill root.

rule: Adapters expose or reference skills; they never grant filesystem scope, secrets, connections, approvals, memory authority, or scheduling. AI-Verse OS compatibility is external-reference only.
